statements: the safe-mode report from the owner's phone (HONOR BRP-NX1M, API 36, 6.1.1 lite): java.lang.VerifyError: Verifier rejected class com.ketvoice.app.automix.Automix (transition, copy-cat1 v5<-v286), at MainActivity.onStart

done.cause: Automix.transition grew to 287 registers in 6.1.0 (Ketmix editor points); ART rejects such dex code on the device, so the whole Automix class failed to load at launch. JVM/Robolectric tests never run the ART verifier, which is why the 6.1.0 and 6.1.1 test suites passed
done.fix: transition split into analyse, startStems and joinStems with the same behaviour; 144 registers in the release dex (largest Ketvoice method now)
done.guard: tools/check_dex_registers.py fails CI when any com.ketvoice method in a release APK needs 256 registers or more; it reports the 6.1.1 APKs as broken and the 6.1.2 builds as clean

not_validated: 6.1.2 installed and launched on a device (the owner's Honor in particular): the fix follows the verifier's exact message and the dex now stays far under the limit, but ART verification itself was not run here
physical phone, Lite or Quest installation, rendering and behaviour

known_limitations: No Wear OS app in this version.
Android Auto's queue screen shows only the current song.
Switching between Ketvoice and Ketvoice Lite is a manual install of the other APK.
Ketogether guests hear titles their own sources can play; local files and private titles are shown as unavailable.
Launcher icons keep a background: Android fills adaptive icon backgrounds in black.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
